rule: COMPOSITION_ONLY if no standalone decision; REJECTED if more wrong than baseline or significantly worse than baseline; EXPERIMENTAL if no significant edge over baseline (nor equal quality at >=1.25x lower median latency); SUPERSEDED if competitor significantly better and candidate wins none, or all ties and competitor >=1.25x cheaper; NICHE_CAPABILITY if beats baseline but significantly worse than competitor with some wins, or more wrong than competitor, or ties competitor at >=1.25x cost; DEFAULT_FOR_GEOMETRY if beats baseline, not significantly worse than competitor, no more wrong, and significantly better or <=1.25x competitor median latency. A competitor declared non-deployable (an oracle upper bound) is a reported reference: it neither supersedes nor demotes, so a candidate that beats its baseline without more wrong answers is DEFAULT_FOR_GEOMETRY. One-sided exact sign tests, alpha 0.05, 30 held-out seeds recorded in the freeze.
diagnostics: reported diagnostics, never inputs to the admission decision: the rule decides on wall-clock medians only. cpu_seconds is the calling thread's CPU time per call (time.thread_time; work on other threads or processes is not in it); diagnostics.median_cpu_seconds is its median per arm; host_load is the host's load at the start and end of the run

collective_ecology_bidding.baseline: static: the best pooled warm-up species per unit cost, budget split evenly across tasks
collective_ecology_bidding.competitor: certainty-equivalent online allocator: the same receding-horizon budgeted planner fed the (species, context) Beta posterior means, updated online from the same outcomes

meta_active_inference.competitor: limited-lookahead Bayesian decision theory, horizon 2, pure expected loss (the active-inference ablation without the epistemic term); selected over myopic VOI and greedy information gain per cost by dev regret to the DP optimum
